description: Find the Wayback Machine capture of a web page closest to a given date. Give 'at' to ask for a moment in time; leave it out for the most recent capture. The answer always states 'days_from_requested', because the closest capture can be years away from the date asked for: read it before describing what the page said on that date. It also states the address the capture is of, which the Wayback Machine can resolve to a neighbouring form of the one asked about. This finds the capture and links to it. It does not return the page's contents.

at.description: Date to aim for, as YYYY-MM-DD or a full ISO 8601 timestamp. Omit for the newest capture.

url.description: Address to look up, such as 'lemonde.fr' or a full URL.

name: get_snapshot

address.description: The address this capture is of. The Wayback Machine indexes a site under several addresses at once, such as its www form, its https form and a form carrying credentials, so this can differ from the address that was asked about.

days_from_requested.description: Whole days between this capture and the moment asked for, counted down: a capture taken on the day asked about, when no time was given, is 0. Null when no date was given.

status.description: What the original site answered when it was captured.

url.description: The capture itself, readable as it was on that date.

title: Read a page as it was
